description: In session.rs, SieveCache is Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, Arc<CompiledScript>>>>. Every inbound message delivery path calls sieve_global, which acquires the Mutex to look up the compiled script. Since the global script changes rarely (only on admin PUT/activate), the hot path holds a Mutex for what is effectively a read-only lookup. Fix: replace with a RwLock so concurrent deliveries do not serialize on the read path, or use ArcSwap / watch channel to publish script updates without any lock on the read path.
title: smtp: SieveCache locks global Mutex for every message delivery
